title: Central Approximate Differentially Private Minimax Risk for Holder-Smooth Pointwise CATE
banked_reason: Re-tiered from accepted on 2026-09-09: fully proved in Lean, but the strict anchored D0.5.G re-score (6.7, subfield) found that for beta < gamma only an unmatched bracket is proved and the matched beta = gamma rate is inherited from private regression; the mathematics was not refuted.
tldr: The project asks for the sharp central approximate-differential-privacy minimax risk of a Holder-smooth pointwise observational CATE in the Kennedy--Balakrishnan--Robins--Wasserman regime 0<beta<=gamma. The established non-private causal benchmark and the known central-private pointwise-regression calibration are treated as barriers, not as new results. The unresolved question is whether privately learning causal nuisances creates a further leading regime; its resolution requires a private higher-order local R-score upper bound and a lower bound that preserves joint CATE, propensity, and outcome-regression perturbations.
gap: No published result characterizes the central-(epsilon_n,delta_n)-DP pointwise minimax risk of an observational Holder CATE while retaining the causal nuisance geometry of the non-private problem.
fill: The project poses the exact observational frontier, with a concrete private higher-order local-score and causal-DP-tracing handle for its matching upper and lower bounds.
